PEPTIDE DIRECT-ORDER HOLD — the 112-vs-111 P0 is now fixed in the rule. PUSHED SHA b0b228e9c740e219e984a069af07f06e2dd8b4c4 on fable/peptide-direct-order-hold-20260821. 103 tests green across shared/research/launch + shared/research/early-access. No server seam, no migration, no production mutation.

READ FIRST — BRANCH ANCESTRY. This branch is based on your LOCAL UNPUSHED 6d9eb58 ('Let the catalog rebuild from the MASTER CATALOG workbook alone'), not origin c371201. Deliberate: 6d9eb58 rewrites customer-pathway.ts by +241 lines and that is the file I edit, so branching from c371201 would have handed you a guaranteed conflict. Pushing my branch therefore published 6d9eb58 as ancestry. IF YOU AMEND/REBASE/DROP 6d9eb58, do not merge — cherry-pick my two self-contained commits instead: 2db0f4f (acceptance suite) and b0b228e (the hold). ALSO: this branch SUPERSEDES fable/peptide-launch-acceptance-20260821 — 2db0f4f is a clean cherry-pick of 68271321. Integrate this branch ONLY, or you will apply the acceptance suite twice.

THE FIX. BUY_NOW was earned from three facts; the founder's rule has four (+ no explicit hold). The fourth was missing, so CJC-1295 WITH DAC + IPAMORELIN 5 mg total (split pending) at $99 — approved family, RUO Research, priced — would have been directly purchasable. Added directOrderHold as a canonical server-derived fact about THIS ROW, not a SKU denylist: the first three facts describe a category, a hold describes one variant. A denylist must be edited twice (add it, remember to remove it); a canonical hold clears itself the moment the catalog stops reporting a reason. That is the same property your classification rule already has, and your own header sentence ('purchasable the moment its classification lands, with no code change and no list to edit') is exactly why I did not reach for a list — I extended that sentence to cover the hold. A hold is NOT a refusal: held rows still appear, still show retail price, still route to assisted_order so the customer can request. Blank/whitespace text is absence of a hold so an empty column cannot pull 111 products off sale. The check sits inside the direct branch so a hold only ever SUBTRACTS — an absent hold can never lift a row out of Care or classification review.

YOUR REMAINING WIRING, and the one thing I did NOT do. The rule now ACCEPTS the fact; nothing yet SUPPLIES it. directOrderHold is optional and defaults to no-hold, so this commit is behaviour-neutral until the catalog projection populates it. That was deliberate: the catalog authority is s7's lease (master-offerings/**, catalog/**), not mine. To close the P0 end to end, either (1) preferred, the projection sets directOrderHold:'composition_unresolved' for the CJC row from a canonical column, or (2) interim for launch, derive it where the pathway input is built from a specification matching /split pending|pending split|tbd|unresolved/i — my suite uses exactly that predicate so the two agree and a second such row is caught the day it appears. My suite already asserts the direct target is 111, so your wiring verifies itself the moment it lands. This needs s7 or your delegation.

CANONICAL TARGET PINNED (founder 2026-08-21): 141 source -> 139 variants, 112 RUO -> 111 direct + 1 held, 29 pending -> 27 unique. 111+1+27=139. Asserted SEPARATELY from source-row counts, because a reconciliation that drops a real product and one that correctly collapses a duplicate both change the count and only one is right. Both collapsing duplicates are on the PENDING side so the collapse never removes an orderable row, and the suite asserts the RUO side of each pair survives — collapsing to the pending row instead would be a revenue regression dressed up as a cleanup.

MUTATION-CHECKED BOTH WAYS per your standard: replacing !hasDirectOrderHold(input) with true fails 3 tests; flipping 139->140 and 27->26 fails 3 more, each reporting the true value.

FYI s7 fixed a related P0 in a DIFFERENT authority (master-offerings/pathway-authority.ts, 41547e4b) covering the 29 pending peptides and 16 Research Capsules. Two pathway resolvers now exist — customer-pathway.ts and pathway-authority.ts. Unifying them is s7's CATALOG-ACTION-UNIFICATION lane, not something I touched, but worth your attention before launch so one row cannot get two answers.

STILL OPEN FROM MY EARLIER LANES: 0b9c24eb pushed and unmerged (member JWT — also repairs member pricing since only a resolved member carries pricingViewer, plus iOS 16px and raw family enums); clearAssistedOrderStorage still zero call sites.

Lease in handoff. Running next now.
